Tried looking at a previous thread under this topic but had no success.

Thanks,

Ezequiel

also his MacOSX version is 10.8.0, which is, infact, very much older
than the old version we use to build the binary with,

hruemac:~ hrue$ sw_vers
ProductName: Mac OS X
ProductVersion: 10.10.5
BuildVersion: 14F2009

while the newest version is 10.12

since MaxOSX does not have static builds, some of the system libs will
be loaded at startup, and this is not necessarily backward compatible.
this is why I keep one MacMini with old OS...
